mapper.select: SELECT account_id, account_name, concat(ifnull(account_address,''), ' ', ifnull(account_address_detail,'')) as account_address, case account_type when 1 then '요양원' when 2 then '도소매' when 3 then '프랜차이즈' when 4 then '산업체' else '학교' end as account_type, account_rqd_member, account_headcount, meal_type, del_yn FROM the_full.tb_account WHERE del_yn = 'N'

SELECT M.meal_slot_code, M.meal_slot_name, COALESCE(S.display_order, M.display_order) AS display_order, CASE WHEN S.account_id IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS selected_yn FROM the_full_order.tb_meal_slot_master M LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_slot_setting S ON S.meal_slot_code = M.meal_slot_code AND S.account_id = #{account_id} WHERE M.active_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN S.account_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(S.display_order, M.display_order), M.display_order
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_meal_slot_setting (account_id, meal_slot_code, display_order, created_at, user_id) VALUES
(#{account_id}, #{mealSlot.meal_slot_code}, #{mealSlot.display_order}, NOW(), #{user_id})
mapper.select: SELECT B.account_id, B.account_type, CASE B.account_type WHEN 1 THEN '요양원' WHEN 4 THEN '산업체' WHEN 5 THEN '학교' ELSE '미지원' END AS account_type_name, B.meal_slot_code, B.meal_slot_name, B.main_meal_count, B.budget_per_person, B.budget_source, B.budget_source_amount, B.budget_divisor, COALESCE(B.default_food_type, CASE WHEN B.meal_slot_code IN (1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8) THEN 6 ELSE 1 END) AS default_food_type, COALESCE(B.default_meal_plan_type, 0) AS default_meal_plan_type, B.template_id, T.template_name FROM the_full_order.vw_account_meal_slot_budget B LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_meal_composition_template T ON T.template_id = B.template_id WHERE B.account_id = #{account_id} ORDER BY B.meal_slot_code
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_meal_slot_profile (account_id, meal_slot_code, default_food_type, default_meal_plan_type, template_id, created_at, user_id) VALUES
(#{account_id}, #{mealSlot.meal_slot_code}, COALESCE(#{mealSlot.default_food_type}, 1), COALESCE(#{mealSlot.default_meal_plan_type}, 0), #{mealSlot.template_id}, NOW(), #{user_id})
